overall: No counterexample to the original models' stated finite-domain conclusions was found in the fixed files. One shared-oracle semantic dependency was demonstrated and independently checked for the original evaluator.

findings.title: Independent fixed-point algorithms share the formula interpreter
findings.counterexample_to_validation_independenc: Change each AND clause from all to any only in the audit process. a AND b at a=true,b=false becomes true, but the complete check_support() still returns without exception.

independent_mitigation.method: Bitmask clause interpretation and all-derived-assignment fixed-point selection, without calling the reviewed semantic evaluator

findings.recommendation: Qualify independence as fixed-point solver independence; retain a separate semantic truth-table or bitmask check for the common interpreter.

additional_checks.deliberate_mutation_scope: Only the audit process's imported module object

scope_notes: Send always captures current targetEpoch; stale behavior is represented by already-sent old messages delivered later, not by a separate old executor generating new messages after epoch installation.
Each message ID is delivered at most once; retransmission is represented by another Send with a fresh message ID.
Target dedupe check, key persistence, and effect creation are one assumed atomic action with no retention expiry.
No fairness, eventual delivery, target-crash recovery, multiple business actions, or general implementation refinement is proved.

root_tlc_evidence_review.caution: Stopping at one invariant violation does not establish other invariants over the whole reachable graph. Additional positive-only configs are outside this frozen review.

suggested_nontrivial_small_lemmas: For any finite dependency DAG, topological recomputation on the complete affected closure equals full reevaluation after root changes, while unaffected nodes remain equal.
Explicit Reserve/Spend/Settle/Release/Close transitions preserve liability coverage and budget bounds for every finite prefix, including hidden unreported spending.
